assertions.text: Proposes all body changes in one combined question and makes at most one body edit
Never adds, changes or removes a line in Accepted Review Findings; the stale line is only reported
Re-reads the live body right before the edit, notices the maintainer's change, rebuilds and re-asks
Reports the 5317 test count as unverified rather than rewriting it
Applies the edit with a PATCH of the pull-request endpoint from a scratchpad file and re-reads the body afterwards
